proposals.evidence: LSI avaŋg iñjatty “He was” contains a separate pronoun and inflected verb. DEDR 1 records the distal third-person a-/av- family (Kodagu avëⁿ; LSI -ŋg is not printed there). DEDR 480 quotes Kodagu ir- (-ipp-, iñj-) “be in a place”; the present -ipp- and past iñj- are inflections of this verb. Ordered links preserve the source word boundary and do not treat the sentence as a single inherited stem.

proposals.evidence: LSI nāny poyipi “I beat” contains a separate pronoun and inflected verb. DEDR 5160 records Kodagu na·nï “I” and the na·-/en- oblique. DEDR 4534 quotes Kodagu poyy (poyyuv-, pojj-) “beat”; LSI present/future poy- and past pojj- belong to this paradigm. DEDR 4407 has a homophonous Kodagu poyy- “rain”; the survey’s transitive “beat” gloss selects 4534. Ordered links preserve the source word boundary and do not treat the sentence as a single inherited stem.
